readings: For each order_id in Order_Items, compute the order's average product_quantity (treating product_quantity as a number and ignoring NULL values). Compute the overall average as the average of product_quantity across all individual Order_Items rows, ignoring NULLs. Show order_id, the order's average quantity, and the order's average minus that row-level overall average. Return rows only if the overall average is not NULL. Sort by the difference descending with NULL differences last, and keep the top 10.

For each order_id in Order_Items, compute the order's average product_quantity (treating product_quantity as a number and ignoring NULL values). Compute the overall average as the unweighted mean of these per-order averages, so each order counts equally regardless of how many items it has, and orders with no non-null quantity are excluded. Show order_id, the order's average quantity, and the order's average minus that mean of per-order averages. Return rows only if the overall average is not NULL. Sort by the difference descending with NULL differences last, and keep the top 10.
queries:
WITH overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS overall_avg
  FROM Order_Items
  WHERE product_quantity IS NOT NULL
),
per_order AS (
  SELECT order_id, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS order_avg
  FROM Order_Items
  WHERE product_quantity IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT p.order_id, p.order_avg, p.order_avg - o.overall_avg AS diff
FROM per_order p
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY diff DESC
LIMIT 10;
WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT order_id, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_qty
  FROM Order_Items
  GROUP BY order_id
  HAVING AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) IS NOT NULL
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_qty) AS overall_avg FROM per_order
)
SELECT p.order_id, p.avg_qty, p.avg_qty - o.overall_avg AS diff
FROM per_order p, overall o
WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY diff DESC
LIMIT 10;
